data.title: Significant Figures
data.statement:
Given an string, [[n]], determine [[sig figs]], the number of significant figures present.

For the purpose of this clash, [[sig figs]] is determined using the following four rules:
1. The digits {{1-9}} are always significant.
2. Any {{zeros}} before the first occurrence of {{1-9}} is <<never>> significant.
3. Any {{zeros}} between occurrences of {{1-9}} are <<always>> significant.
4. {{Zeros}} after the last occurrence of {{1-9}} are only significant if there is a decimal point present <<anywhere>> in the number.

A number with no zeros will have all of its digits be significant.

lastVersion.statementHTML:
Goal

Given an string, n, determine sig figs, the number of significant figures present.

For the purpose of this clash, sig figs is determined using the following four rules:
1. The digits 1-9 are always significant.
2. Any zeros before the first occurrence of 1-9 is never significant.
3. Any zeros between occurrences of 1-9 are always significant.
4. Zeros after the last occurrence of 1-9 are only significant if there is a decimal point present anywhere in the number.

A number with no zeros will have all of its digits be significant.
Input
Line 1: a string, n
Output
sig_figs, the number of significant figures in n
Constraints
1≤ length of n ≤ 20
n consists only of decimal digits (0–9) and at most one decimal point (.).
If present, the decimal point is neither the first nor the last character of n.
Example
Input
0.0000005090
Output
4
